title: Event registration with capacity
story: Registration for a limited-capacity event, with a server-enforced waitlist.

durability.basis: transcribed from the pilot archetype and hand-reviewed; test/spec.test.mjs keeps the two in step

state.lifetime: per process, in a file named on the command line - not a durable store

tables.name: records
tables.purpose: the value a write stores, read back by the reference the server issued

persistence.reference: server-issued reference, returned in the Location header of a 303
persistence.reload_assertion: reloading /registration/<ref> still shows the stored attendee name

routes.effect: refuse the submission if a required field is missing; otherwise apply the capacity rule, store the registration, and redirect
read the registration by reference and show the attendee name back

validation.on_missing: the server refuses the submission and re-renders the form; nothing is stored
validation.on_success: insert one row into records and answer 303 with Location: /registration/<ref>

acceptance: after a successful submit the browser lands on /registration/<ref> and the echoed attendee name is present
reloading that URL still shows it
the capacity rule is enforced by the server, so the fourth registration is waitlisted rather than silently accepted
